subject: Duplicate saved view names

thread.author: Maya / Northwind
thread.message: Two teammates used the same view title and the selector looked duplicated.

thread.author: Support / Elena
thread.message: Shared views display their owner. Renaming the team view distinguishes it from personal views.

thread.author: Maya / Northwind
thread.message: Confirmed the owner label and renamed the shared view. The issue is resolved for our team.

next_action: No further action; retain the confirmed resolution.
